validation.method: Scan (no text layer). Every table page read by eye from 200-dpi crops (two table pages per image at 0.7x, 15 images, plus full-resolution views of all transmission, electrical, hardware and decal pages and zooms on every doubtful row). The committed 8-3100 file (sibling book, same engines) was used only as a draft for the pages the two books share; each row was compared with this book's own table and 46 rows carry a different part number or are new, 4 more a different quantity. The transmission and drive pages (printed 39-53) exist only in this book and were transcribed from scratch. Numerical index (printed pages 64-68) read by eye at full resolution (5 half-page images) in sort order against the expected index generated from the transcription.
validation.refContinuity: Refs not printed (as in 8-3100): carburetor 1014/1016 ref 9; blower housing refs 4 and 20; hood ref 23; electrical hardware ref 13 (the index lists none of these). 16 unnumbered rows kept and flagged: gasket set/kit rows (pp5, 7), C28030 fuel-line insulation, carburetor overhaul kits and both carburetor assemblies (pp13, 15), C30589 differential assembly, C30888/C30889 housing assemblies, C30580 and C30585 pinion assemblies (pp41, 43), C27418 starting motor (p55), C28962 clip and C22571 headlight assembly (p61). Paint and oil restarts at 1 for the OIL list.
validation.quantities: Every row has a qty except the p7 gasket kit C27335 and carburetor 1012 ref 7 (pin, float hinge): none printed. UAR on 10 rows. Differential ref 4 (PIN - drive) prints '11': stored as 1 by user decision 2026-11-11 (typo), printed value kept in the flag. REQ'D printed about half a row low on printed pages 33, 41, 45, 47, 49, 51, 53 and 61 (steering, differential, gear-case brake, travel control, drive belts, spindle and drive disc, neutral cam, input shaft, drive chain, both traction-arm tables, electrical hardware, headlight): mapped in sequence, counts equal in every table, 219 rows flagged 'inferred qty'.
validation.numericalIndex: 894 index entries (part, page, ref; hardware printed with a leading zero, e.g. 011- 312) compared in sort order, both directions: every transcribed row except the 22 NSS rows and the 10 paint and oil rows is in the index with the same page and ref, and the index has no entry that is not in the transcription. The index agrees with the table on every doubtful reading: BR 27352 (9/3), 111- 102 (25/24), 111- 202 (33/4), C27370 (21/19), C25742 (13/13), C29314 (27/1), 132- 311 (35/24), C18814 (7/49), 187-1047 (7/38). Unlike 8-3100, the Headlight and Rear Reflector table is indexed. C30507 (engine mount kit footnote) is not indexed.
validation.partNoForms: Briggs BR numbers stored bare (391406), Case C numbers closed up (C30843), hardware codes stored 'NNN-NNNN' (187-1508) without the index's leading zero; footnote marks (*, **) dropped from partNo and kept in partNoAsPrinted. Doubtful hardware prefixes kept as printed and flagged: 11-312, 13-624, 13-628, 14-712, 83-520. 'BR 27352' is stored 27352 with source briggs as printed (8-3100 prints C 27352). NSS rows store partNo NSS with the 'use ...' text in desc.
validation.userDecisions: 2026-11-11: (1) 1016 on the seat and fenders before-PIN page confirmed as before 14116701 (inferred); (2) harness C31036 on the after-PIN page stored for the 1014 only, because C31443 is the harness for all 1016; (3) differential ref 4 qty 11 is a typo, stored as 1; (4) the 1016 gets the same attachment list as the 1012/1014 (source user).
